import json
prog="def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid)
    split=next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==5 for x in r))
    top=[r for r in grid[:split] if any(x not in (0,5) for x in r)]
    bot=[r for r in grid[split+1:] if any(x not in (0,5) for x in r)]
    from collections import Counter
    ct=Counter(x for r in top for x in r if x not in (0,5))
    cb=Counter(x for r in bot for x in r if x not in (0,5))
    colors=set(ct)|set(cb)
    w=max(colors,key=lambda c:(cb.get(c,0)-ct.get(c,0),cb.get(c,0)))
    n=len(colors)
    return [[w]*n for _ in range(n)]
"
